Today’s lot

Ten executives, dealt from a shuffled bag — the whole roster comes out in a random order before anyone repeats. Each one you collar keeps their own face and clothes, drops whatever they were carrying, and joins the line behind you in handcuffs.

    Endless. Speed ramps from one step every 0.30s to 0.11s by a score of 30. Your best is kept in this browser.
